field.label: Load driver at boot
field.help: Load if_vcigb early at boot so LAN1-8, GE1 and GE2 exist before the interfaces are configured. Takes effect at the next boot.

field.label: Fallback module
field.help: When no module was built for the running kernel yet (e.g. right after a kernel update), load the newest installed one anyway. It usually works across minor kernel updates; without it the I354 ports stay down until a matching module is installed.

field.label: Serial console on micro-USB (COM2)
field.help: Point the loader serial console at COM2 (0x2F8), the micro-USB port. Enable the serial console itself in System: Settings: Administration (Console: Serial, 115200).
